sets.q: Skip-count by 5s: 50, 55, 60, ____
Skip-count by 10s: 20, 30, 40, ____
Which number is not a multiple of 5?
sets.why: Multiples of 5 end in 0 or 5. 52 ends in 2.
no: 25 ends in 5. It is a multiple of 5.
40 ends in 0. It is a multiple of 5.
85 ends in 5. It is a multiple of 5.

sets.q: Hand warmers cost $5 a pack. Coach buys 4 packs. What is the total?
sets.why: 4 × 5 = 20. The total is $20.

sets.q: Lunch boxes cost $10 each. A family buys 5. What is the total?
Caps cost $5 each. Flora buys 6. Which number sentence finds the total?
sets.why: Same price for each cap, 6 caps: 6 × 5 = 30. The total is $30.
no: That adds the price and the quantity. 6 caps at $5 each are 6 equal groups.
Nothing is taken away.

sets.q: Mia cared about how the tired hiker felt. That caring is called ____.
sets.why: Caring about how someone else feels is empathy.

sets.q: How does Abe feel? Type one word.
sets.why: He slammed the door and threw his bag. He feels angry.
sets.no: Look at what he did with the door and his bag.

visual.text: Abe got home at three. His backpack was blue. He slammed the door. He threw his backpack on the floor.

sets.q: Which detail is the best clue that Abe is angry?
sets.why: Slamming a door is a clue that someone is angry.
no: The time does not tell how he feels.
The color of a bag does not tell how he feels.

visual.text: Abe got home at three. His backpack was blue. He slammed the door. He threw his backpack on the floor.

sets.q: How did the aunt feel at the top?
choices: happy to see the whole town
sets.why: She held on tight and shut her eyes. She was scared.
no: That was Vince's point of view.
The story does not say she was sleepy.

visual.text:
The Ferris wheel stopped at the very top. Vince laughed and waved at the town below.
His aunt held the bar tight and shut her eyes.

sets.q: In The Grumpy Hiker, Theo's hurt feelings were real. Mia's idea was probably ____ too.
sets.why: Both views can be true at the same time.
sets.no: Both views can be real. Mia's idea was probably t…

sets.q: What does interpret mean?
choices: to skip-count by fives or by tens out loud
to tell what something means to you
to buy many of the same thing
sets.why: To interpret is to explain what something means to you.
no: That is skip-counting.
That is a quantity of one item.

sets.q: Skip-count by 5s: 80, 85, 90, ____
Skip-count by 10s: 30, 40, 50, ____
Which number do you land on when you skip-count by 5?
sets.why: Multiples of 5 end in 0 or 5. 40 ends in 0.
no: 32 ends in 2.
36 ends in 6.
44 ends in 4.

sets.q: Bookmarks cost $5 each. Della buys 5. What is the total?
sets.why: 5 × 5 = 25. The total is $25.

sets.q: Pillows cost $10 each. Grandpa buys 3. What is the total?
Which problem needs multiplying?
choices: A cap is $5. A bag is $10.
sets.why: Same price for each kite, 4 kites: 4 × 10 = $40.
no: Spent means take away. Subtract.
Two different prices. Add them.

sets.q: Theo and Mia each had their own point of ____.
sets.why: Each one had a point of view.

sets.q: How does Rory feel? Type one word.
sets.why: His hands shook and his voice was quiet. He feels nervous.
sets.no: Look at his hands and his voice.

visual.text: Rory stood up in front of the class. He held his paper. His hands shook. His voice was very quiet.

sets.q: Which detail is the best clue that Rory is nervous?
sets.why: Shaking hands are a clue that someone is nervous.
no: Holding a paper does not show a feeling.
Lots of kids stand up in class. It is not the best clue.

visual.text: Rory stood up in front of the class. He held his paper. His hands shook. His voice was very quiet.

sets.q: How did Rex feel about the storm?
sets.why: Rex hid and shook. He was scared.
no: That was Grandpa's point of view.
Shaking is not a clue for sleepy.

visual.text:
Thunder boomed. Rex the dog hid under the bed and shook.
Grandpa sat on the porch and smiled. “I love a good storm,” he said.

sets.q: In The Grumpy Hiker, what were the hiker's boots caked in?
sets.why: His boots were caked in mud. He had walked a long way.
sets.no: Muddy boots! What makes boots muddy?

sets.q: What is point of view?
choices: the big lesson that a story teaches you
the way one person sees a moment
sets.why: Point of view is the way one person sees a moment.
no: That is the theme.
That is the conflict.
